sources.title: BGA Studio framework reference

license.statedAt: Checked the Main Page footer, the About and Disclaimers links, and the page footers on 2026-08-07. No content licence is published.
license.notes: No stated licence means all rights reserved, not public domain. Linking and short attributed quotation only; the full text of a page is never reproduced or redistributed.

retrieval.notes: One page per explicit developer request. The site refuses every named AI crawler outright, so building a corpus from it is out of the question whatever the general Allow says; a single requested lookup is what search=yes and use=reference describe.

sources.updateSignal: The MediaWiki page footer carries a last-edited timestamp, and Special:RecentChanges lists edits. Both are read to date a snapshot rather than assume it is current.
sources.notes: The framework reference pages are maintained by the BGA team, but the wiki is editable, so this source is authoritative about the framework and still attacker-influenced. Both facts are recorded because both matter.

sources.title: BGA Studio community pages on the official wiki

license.statedAt: Same wiki, same footers, checked 2026-08-07. No content licence is published.
license.notes: Contributed recipes carry no separate licence and no individual attribution, so they are quoted briefly with a link and never reproduced.

retrieval.notes: Same host and same signals as the framework reference. The distinction is authority, not access.

sources.updateSignal: Page last-edited timestamp. These pages change more often and less predictably than the maintained reference, so a result from here is dated more conservatively.
sources.notes: The page invites anyone to add recipes and BGA does not vouch for individual entries, so a rule derived from here is a heuristic and a result from here is labelled community, never official — even though the URL is on the official host.
